sp_widget.name: CAH Key Features
sp_widget.template:
POWERFUL FEATURES

Everything You Need to Manage Campus Assets

A single platform for students, faculty, and administrators to manage the complete asset lifecycle.

QR Self-Service

Scan and check out assets quickly using QR or barcode technology.

AI-Powered Reminders

Receive smart notifications before assets become overdue.

Real-Time Dashboard

Track asset availability, requests, returns, and utilization.

Predictive Insights

Identify potential shortages and return delays before they happen.

Automated Restocking

Trigger restocking workflows based on inventory requirements.

Full Lifecycle Tracking

Manage assets from request and checkout to return and maintenance.
